parameters.content:
## Day 90 Solution: Content Marketing

Records a content calendar and one fully-written piece (not just a title). Sticky note below is a worked example post.

**Credentials needed:** None (add Slack/Notion if you wire up real publishing).

See `DAILY_TASKS/DAY_90_Content_Marketing.md`.

## Model LinkedIn Post

"I spent 3 hours this week rebuilding a client's lead-routing workflow because their old one silently failed for 6 weeks. No alerts, no logs, nothing.

The fix wasn't clever — it was one Slack alert node on the failure path. That's it.

If your automation doesn't tell you when it breaks, it's not automation. It's a liability with extra steps."
